title: Sulfone-quinone derivatives: a review on their synthetic methods, properties and applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17825-17847
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01093H, Review Article
Open Access

This review presents seven synthetic approaches for sulfone compounds and two for quinone compounds, along with a discussion on their physical and chemical properties and reactivities with various organic compounds.
